shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo "-----" && find .agents -type f | head -100 && echo "-----" && cat AGENTS.md | head -100 && echo "-----" && ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null

head -80 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && echo "-----SRC" && find src -type f && echo "-----" && cat src/*.tsx src/*.ts 2>/dev/null | head -150 && echo "-----NM" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ && for p in node_modules/@gravity-ui/*; do echo "$p $(node -p "require('./$p/package.json').version")"; done && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/docs 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build | head -30

cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && echo "-----INSPECT" && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Table withTableSorting withTableSelection Pagination 2>&1 | head -80

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Table withTableSorting withTableSelection Pagination 2>&1 | head -80; echo "-----"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs | head; grep -rl "withTableSorting" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs --include=*.d.ts | head; grep -rl "withTableSorting" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm --include=*.d.ts | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && ls components/Table components/Table/hoc components/Table/hoc/* && echo "----- index" && cat components/Table/index.d.ts && echo "----- hoc" && cat components/Table/hoc/index.d.ts && cat components/Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.d.ts && echo "----- Table.d.ts" && cat components/Table/Table.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -200

cat components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.d.ts && echo "----- SORT JS" && cat components/Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.js | head -150 && echo "----- PAGINATION d.ts" && cat components/Pagination/Pagination.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -120; ls components/Pagination

cat components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.js && echo "----- PAGINATION types" && cat components/Pagination/types.d.ts && echo "----- index" && cat components/Pagination/index.d.ts && echo "---- root index export check" && grep -n "Table\|Pagination" index.d.ts components/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20

grep -n "static getRowId" -A 25 components/Table/Table.js | head -40; echo "----- PAG"; grep -n "page" components/Pagination/Pagination.js | head -60; echo "----- utils"; grep -n "page" components/Pagination/utils.js | head -30; grep -rn "getPageCount\|Math.ceil" components/Pagination/*.js | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && cat tsconfig.json && echo "-----" && grep -n "Flex\|direction\|gap" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/layout.md | head -30 && echo "-----" && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Flex/Flex.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/ 2>/dev/null

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && f=$(grep -rl "export declare const Flex" --include=*.d.ts . | head -1); echo "FLEX FILE: $f"; grep -n "gap\|space\|direction\|alignItems\|justifyContent" "$f" | head -20; echo "----TEXT"; grep -n "variant" components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -10; grep -rn "header-2" components/Text/*.d.ts | head -3; echo "----BUTTON view"; grep -rn "view?:" components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -3
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | head -60; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -25; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
cat .gitignore; echo "----"; ls node_modules | grep -i -E "^(jsdom|happy-dom|@testing-library)$" ; ls node_modules/.bin | grep -E "^vitest$"; git status --short
timeout 120 npx vitest run src/__smoke.test.tsx 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -40; rm -f src/__smoke.test.tsx; echo "temp test removed"
rm -rf dist && git status --short && echo "----" && cat src/DataTable.tsx | sed -n 1,20p
